title: Cobaltfen ChatLab
text:
Cobaltfen ChatLab

notes:
Inbound from product sign-up (self-serve) -> engaged via trial credits. Fast-moving early-stage B2B chat SDK startup building an in-app assistant for product help and micro-support. Wants streaming token-by-token responses for perceived snappiness. P95 latency goal quoted multiple times: <200ms on typical flows (short replies 20-50 tokens).

Highlights from discovery call:
- "Feels slow if reply takes >200ms; streaming is a must." said Head of Product.
- Prototype currently using hosted endpoints from another provider; seeing 300-600ms p95 in EU-US hops; want improvement.
- Prototype traffic: peak concurrency ~40-60 simultaneous users in beta, expect 300+ after launch; planning bursts.
- Cost sensitivity: seed-stage budget, wants predictable per-token pricing and ways to cap spend.
- Data residency not strict; comfortable with public cloud; KMS for keys later.
- Interested in Redwood features: streaming, per-route latency metrics, and simple SDKs for web.

CRM style next-steps and shorthand:
- Sent quickstart + example React streaming component (drive link).
- SE to pair on proof-of-concept integration next wk.
- AE to confirm trial quota bump for weekend load test.


next_step:
Send hosted API quickstart + sample streaming integration (React) and schedule 30m follow-up

blockers:
latency SLO clarification
budget approval from CTO
SAML integration checklist
